stack_samples.note: Approximate sampled wall-time attribution in serialized GPU probe. Categories partition session-render subtree; not exact stage timing or GPU timestamps. Source2 capture uses current table behavior despite old table-stable label; interned3 capture uses diagnostic local interning. Ambient load differs; do not compare capture wall times.

Approximate sampled wall-time attribution in serialized GPU probe. Categories partition session-render subtree; not exact stage timing or GPU timestamps. Source2 capture uses current table behavior despite old table-stable label; interned3 capture uses diagnostic local interning. Ambient load differs; do not compare capture wall times.

notes: Cache ablations and local interning exist only in the private diagnostic probe. Production clears and identity rebinding remain unchanged.
Three 40-frame repetitions per case, with first eight excluded; reverse cache-policy order in second repetition. Eight scroll/resize variants; fonts vary by operating system.
CPU render spans include validation, font/image preparation, path lowering and GPU encoding. Completion wait/readback are separate, not GPU timestamps.
Mac and Windows have concurrent unrelated workspace builds recorded in load receipts. Do not rank hardware or compare separate stack-capture wall times.
Source2 Linux trials used a misleading table-stable label, corrected to table-current in final source3; earlier trials are exploratory only.
Every frame compared exactly to independent cleared-reference pixels; hashes are receipt locators, not the equality check.
